Why Our Certifications Matter

In the ICT infrastructure industry, certifications are not just badges — they are proof of technical competence, commitment to quality, and adherence to industry best practices. When you engage ATLINE SDN BHD, you are working with a team whose skills are validated by the world's leading technology organisations and regulatory bodies.

Our government registrations ensure we meet the procurement requirements of public sector clients, while our vendor certifications mean we have direct access to technical support, latest product training, and competitive pricing from leading manufacturers.

All engineers hold valid, current professional certifications
Government-registered vendor for federal and state procurement
Installations comply with TIA/EIA and ISO international standards
Regular recertification and training to maintain current status
Full PDPA 2010 compliance for all data handling activities
OSH compliant site safety practices for all installations
